FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Can the cleaning be done several times a week?
Yes. The frequency can be adjusted to your needs and budget.
How is key access managed?
We coordinate access arrangements with the property manager or responsible contact.
Are add-ons available?
Yes. Window or glass surfaces can be added when needed.
How are invoices issued?
Monthly or according to the agreed schedule, with transparent itemisation.
